""" Web scraper for extracting API documentation from HTML pages. This initial implementation provides basic HTML parsing functionality that will be evolved to handle complex documentation structures. The LLM will have access to actual documentation pages through optillm's readurls plugin, allowing it to understand the specific HTML structure and improve the parsing logic accordingly. """ from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from typing import Dict, List, Optional import re # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") functions = [] # Try multiple approaches to find functions # 1. Look for dt/dd pairs (Sphinx-style docs) for dt in soup.find_all("dt"): sig_text = dt.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in sig_text and ")" in sig_text: dd = dt.find_next_sibling("dd") desc = dd.get_text(strip=True)[:300] if dd else "No description found" name = sig_text.split("(")[0].strip() functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": sig_text, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(sig_text), }) # 2. Look for headers with descriptions for tag in ["h1", "h2", "h3", "h4"]: for header in soup.find_all(tag): text = header.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: next_p = header.find_next("p") desc = next_p.get_text(strip=True)[:300] if next_p else "No description found" name = text.split("(")[0].strip() functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": text, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), }) # 3. Look for code blocks with nearby descriptions for block in soup.find_all("code"): text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: parent = block.parent desc = "No description found" if parent: next_elem = parent.find_next_sibling() if next_elem: desc = next_elem.get_text(strip=True)[:300] name = text.split("(")[0].strip() functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": text, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), }) # Deduplicate by name and signature (keep first occurrence) seen = set() unique_funcs = [] for func in functions: identifier = f"{func['name']}|{func['signature']}" if identifier not in seen: seen.add(identifier) unique_funcs.append(func) return unique_funcs[:40] # Enhanced parameter extraction logic to handle nested structures, type hints, and defaults. def extract_parameters(signature: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """ Extract parameter information from a function signature. Args: signature: Function signature string Returns: List of parameter dictionaries """ params = [] match = re.search(r"\((.*?)\)", signature) if match: param_string = match.group(1) if param_string: param_parts = [] current = [] depth = 0 for char in param_string + ",": # Add trailing comma for easier parsing if char in "([{": depth += 1 current.append(char) elif char in ")]}": depth -= 1 current.append(char) elif char == "," and depth == 0: param_parts.append("".join(current).strip()) current = [] else: current.append(char) for part in param_parts: if not part: continue name = part.split(":")[0].split("=")[0].strip() param_type = "unknown" default = None # Extract type hint if ":" in part: type_part = part.split(":")[1].split("=")[0].strip() param_type = type_part # Extract default value if "=" in part: default = "=".join(part.split("=")[1:]).strip() # Clean up name (remove *, **, etc.) name = name.lstrip("*").strip() params.append({ "name": name, "type": param_type, "default": default, "description": "", }) return params def format_documentation(api_docs: List[Dict[str, any]]) -> str: """ Format extracted documentation into a readable string. Args: api_docs: List of API documentation dictionaries Returns: Formatted documentation string """ output = [] for doc in api_docs: output.append(f"Function: {doc['name']}") output.append(f"Signature: {doc['signature']}") output.append(f"Description: {doc['description']}") if doc.get("parameters"): output.append("Parameters:") for param in doc["parameters"]: output.append(f" - {param['name']}: {param.get('description', 'No description')}") output.append("") # Empty line between functions return "\n".join(output) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END # Example usage and test if __name__ == "__main__": # Sample HTML for testing basic functionality sample_html = """
json.dumps(obj, indent=2)

Serialize obj to a JSON formatted string.

json.loads(s)

Deserialize s to a Python object.

""" docs = scrape_api_docs(sample_html) print(format_documentation(docs)) print(f"\nExtracted {len(docs)} functions")
